articles.summary: The clock separated first and second place by just 0.04 seconds. McEvoy’s 20.22-second swim in Baku beat the World Cup record, while leaving his next goal—going below 20 seconds—still ahead.
articles.title: A Tiny Winning Margin and an Eleven Year Personal Best

articles.summary: A 4–2 lead turned into a lost second set. Alcaraz responded to Michelsen’s strong play and unfamiliar court conditions, winning the deciding set 6–1 in his Japan Open opener.
articles.title: A Lost Lead Gives Alcaraz a Problem to Solve

articles.summary: Hilary Duff’s CATastrophe accompanies a new preview of the animated film. The Cat’s task is to help two siblings after a move, while the full movie is scheduled for November rather than already playing.
articles.title: A New Cat in the Hat Trailer Mixes Music With an Unusual Mission
